---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or architectural improvement for Local Vulnerability AI
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem or missing capability you are addressing (e.g. "I cannot scan format X with the current engine").

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen and how you envision the user experience or API behavior.

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you've considered.

## Expected Benefits
Why would this feature be valuable to the community and users of Local Vulnerability AI?

## Architectural Impact & Privacy Considerations
Does this feature affect the local-first execution model, data egress, or performance? (Recall: zero-execution and local privacy are core design principles).
